ItemID: NA; Title: Muddy Wolf at Red Rocks; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues focus appeals to me, but I would choose a studio album this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: New; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiar melodic rock fits some of my listening, but I am more interested in blues right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Terraplane; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its rootsy blues sound fits the direction of my recent listening and makes me want to try it.
ItemID: NA; Title: In My Soul; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Soulful blues fits my interest in Memphis and Old Sock, but I would save it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Shadows in the Night; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for guitar-driven blues and roots rock rather than standards right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blak and Blu; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues guitar connection interests me, though I am choosing something more laid-back today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My interest in Old Sock makes this relaxed, guitar-centered tribute an especially appealing choice.
ItemID: NA; Title: Beach Boys' Party! Uncovered And Unplugged; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: An informal pop singalong does not match my current blues and roots-rock mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: Old Yellow Moon; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its roots-oriented songwriting appeals to me, but it is not my first choice on this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Loud Hailer; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its harder-edged sound feels less suited to the relaxed blues listening I want today.
